description: This file is a shell script used for testing the performance of Git pack objects. It defines test scenarios for large repositories, creating different pack configurations (thin, big, shallow), and evaluates their sizes and performance metrics. It relies on sourcing an external library 'perf-lib.sh' for shared functions.

methods.name: test_all_with_args
methods.description: Runs a set of performance and size tests on different pack configurations with specified arguments.
